events.body:
## Context

`DEPLOY.md` has a Deploy button for `github.com/OWASP-BLT/BLT-NetGuardian` and a "Frontend Deployment (GitHub Pages) - legacy" section with github.io URLs; `ARCHITECTURE.md` says "Frontend (GitHub Pages)"; `_config.yml` is Pages config. The product is served from Workers assets plus D1.

## What to do

1. Remove the GitHub Pages instructions and the button.
2. Describe Workers assets in ARCHITECTURE.md.
3. Remove `_config.yml` or explain it.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No github.io or GitHub Pages instructions remain
- [ ] ARCHITECTURE matches the deployment

## How to test locally

```bash
grep -rn "github.io\|GitHub Pages" blt-netguardian/*.md
```

---
